items.description: I need a lightweight Chrome extension that can consistently automate repetitive actions on a specific web platform. The core requirement is simple: once the extension is installed, it should detect selected buttons or links on the page and trigger them programmatically in the exact order and timing I define. All interactions must respect the page’s existing JavaScript and HTML structure, so no server-side changes are expected—just pure front-end automation through the Chrome Extension APIs. The final package must follow Google’s manifest v3 guidelines so it passes the Chrome Web Store review. Deliverables 1. Source code (well-commented) and packed .zip /.crx ready for manual installation. 2. Short README detailing setup, configuration, and how to extend selectors or timings. 3. A brief video or GIF demo showing the extension clicking the designated buttons/links in action. Acceptance criteria: • The extension consistently automates only the elements I whitelist, with no unintended clicks. • It runs error-free on the latest Chrome version across Windows, macOS, and Linux. • Code quality is clear enough that I can tweak selectors or timing rules without digging through complex logic. items.description: Copy-Paste Publishing Assistant(s) for a Nonprofit — 200 Listings/Day Catch-Up, Then Ongoing All Summer (Fully Prepared Content, Manual Only) Category / skills: Data Entry, Virtual Assistant, Copy Typing Description: We're a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit that arranges services for seniors, veterans, disabled neighbors, and families facing hardship. We've built an internal system that automatically writes a recruiting listing for every neighbor who needs help — privacy-screened, fully composed, ready to go. What we need is a human publishing partner (individual or small team) who copies each prepared listing from our private dashboard and pastes it onto a well-known volunteer-recruitment website, by hand. Why by hand? Compliance. The destination website's terms require listings to be reviewed and published by a real person. So this role is 100% manual and that's non-negotiable: no bots, no scrapers, no browser automation, no macros, no scripts — ever. Any automation ends the engagement immediately. ** You are the human in the middle; that's the entire point of the role. ** The task, precisely. Each listing on the destination site is a 5-page form with about 25 fields (title, description, location, time commitment, screening questions, category tags, etc.). Sounds heavy — it isn't: We supply every field. Each card on our dashboard shows the exact text for all 25 fields, page by page, in the same order as the form. You never write, guess, or improvise anything. ~21 of the 25 fields are identical every time. The site has a "duplicate listing" feature — after your first listing, you duplicate and change only what's unique: the title (each carries its own reference code that must be pasted exactly, never shortened), the description, the city, and the photo. The photo is one click. Our dashboard generates a custom image per listing — click download, upload to the form, done. After publishing, click "Mark posted ✓" on our dashboard. Our system verifies it automatically — that's how completed work is counted. With rhythm, each listing takes 2–4 minutes: duplicate → paste title → paste description → set city → download/upload photo → publish → mark posted. The volume, in two phases: Phase 1 — Catch-up: ~3,000 listings at ~200/day (roughly 3 weeks). This clears our 90-day backlog of neighbors waiting for help. Phase 2 — Ongoing: ~25–50/day for the rest of the summer at least, as new requests arrive daily. Strong Phase 1 performers get first claim on this follow-up project

I built and continue to maintain (and add features to) an app on Bubble for a large non-profit. It was 2024 and is now a daily-use application for the non-profit. Last week we found out we won the grant and now need to start planning. There is a LOT to consider here as we expand beyond a single organization, and we are looking for a partner to help with architecting and building out the app. If you are interested, please reach out to me by sending me a direct message. Please give me an idea of the work you’ve done in the past on Bubble and the size of your team. You would be a sub-contractor on this project, so a general sense of your rates would also be useful. I don’t need a formal proposal at this point, just an expression of interest. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have more questions, and I’m happy to provide more details via email. Look forward to hearing from folks!
